notes: Follow-up to the merged per-Text resolution fix (PR #342), which was necessary but insufficient: Phaser 4 sizes the canvas backing store to the fixed 1280x720 design size with no devicePixelRatio multiply, then Scale.FIT nearest-neighbour upscales it, so all detail was capped at 720p (proven via Playwright probe at dpr=2: backing store 1280x720 stretched across ~2560x1440 physical px). Fix = HiDPI supersampling: render the whole game into a design x S framebuffer (S = integer render scale = clamp(round(min(cssW/designW, cssH/designH) * dpr), 1, MAX_RENDER_SCALE=2)) while keeping the 1280x720 design space for gameplay/layout/input via camera zoom. New pure src/engine/render-scale.ts (computeRenderScale/getRenderScale/resolveBootRenderScale + 12 unit tests); floor1-game-config sizes the game design x S; MainGameScene world camera zoom x S (FOV preserved: displayWidth=width/zoom unchanged) and UI camera setOrigin(0,0)+setZoom(S)+viewport design x S (required because HUD/modals are setScrollFactor(0), so only the origin/zoom transform scales them from the top-left -- a scroll offset is ignored); migrated HudUI + ui-scale + 5 modals from scene.scale.width/height (now the backing store) to GAME.WIDTH/HEIGHT design constants; rebuilt computeTextResolution to round(S * uiScale) and based modal text resolution on getRenderScale instead of raw devicePixelRatio; added render-scale-lab (lil-gui S toggle + live readout) and ADR-0025. On a 1x / design-size display S===1 -> complete no-op (CI/e2e at dpr=1 unaffected). Multi-system (boot config + 2 cameras + text model + 5 modals + HudUI) with ADR + new lab justified the 4-apple estimate; probe-proven crisp early so no surprises -> exact. verify:fast green; full verify green on every code gate (typecheck, lint, prettier, knip, unit+coverage, integration, vite build); e2e hud-overlap-visual + equipment/level-up/minimap green. Two environmental flakes proven NOT regressions: (1) headless wall-clock guard tripped on a DIFFERENT seed each run while frame counts stay deterministic (15804 / 19506) and every game-time budget passes -- headless never imports src/engine and boots with no window (S=1); (2) one e2e page.goto networkidle timeout under ~80 shared-session node processes that passed 5/5 in isolation. Did not raise the headless budget (no real regression).
